notes.title: Lycans 0.14.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Lycans has just surpassed 20k sales! Thank you all!
To show our appreciation, here’s a new update that will make wolf gameplay easier, along with a new item and some balancing adjustments.

Now that players are getting better at the game, wolves are finding it increasingly difficult to win matches. Due to the wolf music, villagers know a wolf has transformed even when they’re not in danger, making it really tough for the wolves. I’ve decided to make the following changes to the wolf music, which should help wolves kill more easily and appear innocent during debates.

[list]
[*] Removed the variation in music volume based on the distance from the wolf.
[*] The music takes 0.5 seconds to start when the wolf is within range.
[*] The music takes 2 seconds to fade out when the wolf is no longer within range.
[*] Reduced the trigger range of the wolf’s music.
[*] The trigger range of the wolf’s music is greatly reduced when the wolf is crouching.
[/list]

[u]New item[/u]
[list]
[*] Smoke Bomb: Creates a large smoke cloud in place for 20 seconds.
[/list]

[u]Balancing[/u]
[list]
[*] Wolf trap quantity: Infinite -> 1.
[*] Lock health: 100 -> 80.
[*] The wolf’s hunger bar decreases more slowly when crouching.
[*] Reduced potion spawn rate.
[/list]

[u]Balancing[/u]
[list]
[*]Portals deactivate after a while.
[*]Traps -- Quantity: 3 -> 1 / Capture Duration: 10s -> 20s / Increased size and hitbox.
[/list]

New updates are planned for soon!

Enjoy the game!

Each potion gives a random effect to the player for a limited duration. What are the effects? It's up to you to test them!

[*] Added lootable potions that can appear on the map (configurable)

[*] Increased the hitbox size of ladders for easier selection
[*] Added the ability to remove the voice modifier for wolves
[/list]

[u]Balance Changes[/u]

[*] Transformed wolves can no longer loot

[/list]

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]

notes.title: Lycans 0.7
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.7[/h1]

Happy New Year to everyone! To mark the occasion, here's a new content update for Lycans!

This update introduces new gameplay elements that will make matches even more strategic.

[h3]Hunger System[/h3]

The hunger system has been added to counteract the clustering of villagers and make collectibles more important. With this change, wolves can more easily kill a hunter if they have managed to unmask them.

[u]For Villagers[/u]
[list]
[*] Villagers' hunger bar continuously depletes.
[*] Moving and running consume more hunger.
[*] Collecting food refill the hunger bar based on rarity.
[*] It is impossible to run once the hunger bar is in the red.
[*] When the hunger bar is empty, the player dies.
[*] The hunger bar fills slightly each morning.
[/list]

[u]For Wolves[/u]
[list]
[*] Wolves' hunger bar does not deplete until they transform.
[*] Killing a player completely fills the hunger bar.
[*] It is impossible to run once the hunger bar is in the red.
[*] The hunger bar no longer decreases once in the red.
[*] A hunter's bullet removes 50% of the max hunger bar.
[*] A hunter's bullet kills if the wolf has less than 50% hunger bar.
[/list]

[h3]Minor Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players are teleported to random locations at the start of the game and after meetings (configurable).
[*] The spawn rate of collectibles has been reworked.
[*] Player models can now lean.
[*] Players in spectator mode can now see exactly where players are looking.
[*] The rifle is now visible in first person, pointing where the player aims.
[*] Players no longer automatically join the dead voice chat (added a shortcut to join and leave the dead voice chat).
[*] Changed the icon for dead players.
[*] Doors now close every morning.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players in spectator mode are no longer stuck when a hunter and a wolf kill each other.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706861/3f991f9a23210272d28c9c9138690cb2365e3ec0.png[/img]

notes.title: Lycans 0.6
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.6[/h1]

After listening to your feedback on Lycans, I've added quite a bit of content to the game so you can have an even better time with your friends. 

The two major elements of this update are : The addition of the hunter role and skins. There are also several cool minor changes and bug fixes.

[h3]Major changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Hunter role (customizable)
[*] Added hats
[/list]
[h3]Minor changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added wolf transformation delay (configurable)
[*] Added Wolf transformation animation modified and sound
[*] Voice chat for the dead

[*] Death updates are now instantaneous in spectator mode
[*] Added ability to hide allied wolf
[*] Vote with E key instead of left mouse button
[*] Player interaction hitbox now adapts when ducking or transforming into a wolf
[*] Voice highlight no longer lights up during night
[*] Added ccary visual effects when a wolf is close by
[*] Disconnected player characters are now deleted during meetings and endgames to avoid crashes
[*] Added the ability to return to the previous player in spectator mode
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a voice issue when players were moving
[*] Fixed a crash when a player performed an action just before disconnecting from the game
[*] It is no longer possible to vote for a dead player
[*] Possible game freeze fix occurring randomly during a meeting
[/list]
